# netactuate_packages (Data Source)

Reads Packages visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_packages" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `packages` (List of Object) List of account packages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `installed` (Number)
- `locked` (Number)
- `mbpkgid` (Number)
- `name` (String)
